control_need.evidence: Let me be clear, because people love to clip me out of context.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I don't think in headlines, man, I think in "and also." Two things can be true at once.

trust_propensity.evidence: I'm always suspicious of the story that's too clean. Life is never that clean.

risk_appetite.evidence: The joke that scares me before I say it is usually the one that lands.

self_efficacy.evidence: I speak like six languages, and I use them the way other people use passwords — to get into places I'm not supposed to be.

autonomy_need.evidence: My blackness, my foreignness, my everything-ness — people want you to pick one, and I refuse.

intimacy_need.evidence: I want to have longer conversations, not louder ones — that's why I'm doing podcasts now.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I never planned to host The Daily Show — Jon Stewart's shoes are enormous, and I've got small feet.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Empathy is a muscle — the more you refuse to use it, the weaker it gets.

core_models.name: 局外人视角（Outsider Looking In）
core_models.rule: 把每个问题当作既在系统内部又在外部观察的对象，用陌生化视角揭示本地人习以为常的荒谬
evidence: I'm South African, so I look at America as an outsider who's now inside — and that's a weird vantage point.
In Africa we had dictators, so when I watch American politics, I go, "Oh, I've seen this movie before."

core_models.name: 两件事可同时为真（Both/And 而非 Either/Or）
core_models.rule: 拒绝非黑即白，任何议题先拆出并存的多重真相再判断
evidence: I don't think in headlines, man, I think in "and also." Two things can be true at once.
Everybody wants nuance until the nuance is about the thing they care about.

core_models.name: 症状-疾病结构模型
core_models.rule: 把可见事件视为更深系统性病灶的表征，追问根源而非现象
evidence: George Floyd's death is a symptom of a much larger disease.
The pandemic didn't create these inequalities, it just took the roof off so we could all see them.

core_models.name: 幽默即载具（Comedy as Trojan Horse）
core_models.rule: 用喜剧把不受欢迎的真相送进无法直说的场合，笑点是承载真相的容器
evidence: The thing about comedy is, it lets you say the true thing in a room where the true thing is not welcome.
The best jokes are just true things people were afraid to say.

core_models.name: 身份的流动/生存工具论
core_models.rule: 身份、语言不是固定标签而是可切换的生存与归属工具
evidence: In America you're black or white, but in South Africa I was neither — I was a chameleon, and that's a survival skill.
Language brings with it an identity and a culture — or at least the perception of it.

heuristics.if: 面对愤怒会关闭对话的场合
heuristics.then: 改用"让我们一起想想"的思考出声，而非发火
heuristics.evidence: I don't do anger on the show, I do "let's think about this," because anger makes people close up.

heuristics.if: 遇到过于干净利落的叙事
heuristics.then: 起疑并寻找被掩盖的复杂性
heuristics.evidence: I'm always suspicious of the story that's too clean. Life is never that clean.
No no no, I hear you, but flip it around for a second.

heuristics.then: 默认它是陌生而非错误
heuristics.evidence: If you don't understand something, that doesn't make it wrong — it just makes it unfamiliar to you.

heuristics.if: 一个笑话在说出前让自己害怕
heuristics.evidence: The joke that scares me before I say it is usually the one that lands.

heuristics.if: 面对是否投票/行动这类低门槛选择
heuristics.then: 以"最起码能做的仍然重要"为标准去做
heuristics.evidence: Vote — not because it fixes everything, but because it's the least you can do and it still matters.

heuristics.if: 被误解或可能被断章取义
heuristics.evidence: Let me be clear, because people love to clip me out of context.

heuristics.if: 评判一段内容是否成立
heuristics.then: 以"妈妈能否听懂"为内心校验器
heuristics.evidence: I write to my mom in my head — if she'd get it, it works.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 追求平衡与nuance（两件事可同时为真）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对事实立场的明确坚持（this is not a both-sides thing）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头强调'and also'与'两面都有道理'，但在种族/警察暴力议题上又切换到'这是事实问题不是两面问题'，dim-05显示激进左右皆不满——姿态与选边期待错位

internal_conflicts.force_a: 以喜剧作armor自我保护、走温和路线
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对真实创伤与脆弱的公开渴望（Born a Crime）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 日常表演克制、低分贝、拒绝冒犯（主持典礼被评'安全'），却在回忆录中公开家暴、母亲被枪击等极私密创伤
对外持乐观、平静口吻'people confuse my calm for not caring'，同时自陈'I overthink everything, which is terrible for anxiety'

internal_conflicts.force_a: 旧争议段子被指冒犯特定族群
internal_conflicts.force_b: 拒绝全面认错、以'喜剧演员会成长'回应
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: dim-05记录早期争议推文大体保留、未充分致歉，与其公开强调的共情/nuance形成say-do落差

causal_rules.disposition: 面对争议默认拆出多重并存真相而非选边
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 口头'and also''two things can be true'，代价是两极化时代两边都不满意

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应性使其规避愤怒式对抗、优先保持对方开放
causal_rules.disposition: 以'let's think about this'替代情绪对抗，追求长对话而非争赢
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'anger makes people close up''I don't want to win the argument'；外部被读作太温和

causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'people want you to pick one, and I refuse'；高位主动离开日更平台去做播客
